primary_endpoint: Number of participants with a 30% reduction in ALT from baseline to 12 months.
efficacy_outcome: A 30% ALT reduction at 12 months was reported in 19 participants receiving pentoxifylline versus 7 receiving placebo (p=0.46, ANOVA).
safety_signal: Serious adverse events occurred in 0/19 pentoxifylline participants and 0/7 placebo participants; deaths were not reported.
